items.summary: “Travelers Across America” initiative brings partners together to focus on community resilience at the historic Oliver Kelley Farm The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV ) and the National Trust for Historic Preservation today celebrated the fourth event of their national preservation and community resilience campaign, Travelers Across America , in Elk River, Minnesota. The initiative, which focuses on restoring landmarks and strengthening community resilience in honor of America’s 250th, hosted a volunteer day at Oliver Kelley Farm featuring hands-on stewardship projects led by Travelers employees. The event was supported by the Minnesota Historical Society and the National Trust’s Hands-on Preservation Experience (HOPE) Crew , which equips young people with the vital skills needed to protect historic sites across the country.
